script:
mpiexec --allow-run-as-root --bind-to none -n 1 /bin/true
echo EXPORT_SENTINEL
echo VERIFY_SENTINEL
mpi_version:
mpiexec (Open MPI) 5.0.10

Report bugs to https://www.open-mpi.org/community/help/
